mapper.select: SELECT no,name,poster,type,phone,likecount,replycount FROM food2 ORDER BY no ASC OFFSET #{start} ROWS FETCH NEXT 12 ROWS ONLY
mapper.update: UPDATE food2 SET hit=hit+1 WHERE no=#{no}
mapper.select: SELECT no,poster,name,type,phone,address,score,theme,time,reserve,parking,price,content,images,likecount,replycount,jjimcount,hit,rownum FROM (SELECT no,poster,name,type,phone,address,score,theme,time,reserve,parking,price,content,images,likecount,replycount,jjimcount,hit,rownum FROM food2 ORDER BY hit DESC ) WHERE rownum<=4
